tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows are insufficient to identify the archived five-parameter spatio-temporal siphon-memory ODE. Acquire the fine trajectory batch to reach the stated minimum of eight informative rows before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the spatio-temporal siphon-memory ODE from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The archive identifies a five-parameter coupled ODE, and the supplied mechanism notes specify at least eight rows for fitting; five rows leave its parameters underdetermined.
It is explicitly marked nuisance and provides no relevant identification for the coupled transient-lag signature.
